definitions.explanation: Fog or mist that appears in the early morning, typically lifting as the sun rises.

examples.japanese: {朝霧|あさぎり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ちこめて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The morning fog is hanging thick.

examples.japanese: {朝霧|あさぎり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk in the morning mist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{朝霧|あさぎり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかり→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧、⟦{幻想的|げんそうてき}→幻想的：25756_gensouteki⟧な⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Morning mist hung over the lake, creating a dreamlike landscape.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning) and ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧ (fog/mist). Evokes a quiet, atmospheric image often associated with mountains, lakes, and rural landscapes. Frequently used in poetry, literature, and scenic descriptions. Also used as a place name and ship name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝霧|あさぎり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: morning fog rises
- {朝霧|あさぎり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: morning fog settles over
- {朝霧|あさぎり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧: morning fog clears
- {朝霧|あさぎり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to be enveloped in morning mist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夕霧|ゆうぎり}: evening fog — the counterpart at dusk
- ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧: fog/mist — the general term without time specification
- ⟦{朝靄|あさもや}→朝靄：07866_asamoya⟧: morning haze — lighter and thinner than fog
- ⟦{霞|かすみ}→霞：05042_kasumi⟧: haze — a broader, more diffuse atmospheric phenomenon
